claim_at_time: The scheme was predicted to reduce traffic entering central London by 10 to 15 percent.
evidence_summary: Traffic entering the charging zone during charging hours was about 18 percent below 2002 pre-charge levels.
interpretation: Observed traffic reduction exceeded the original 10 to 15 percent prediction range.

decision: Introduce 5p charge for single-use carrier bags
claim_at_time: Government said the charge could reduce usage by as much as 80 percent in large supermarkets.
evidence_summary: Usage at the main retailers fell by more than 98 percent compared with the pre-charge baseline.
interpretation: The observed reduction ultimately exceeded the government's original up-to-80-percent expectation.
